text:
ina: Quick note 1: marlin-tiny-ptq canary showing odd streaming "EOS wobble" failures on function outputs. Not typical trailing-comma; outputs end with duplicated punctuation or mid-string cuts.

omar: Can you paste a sanitized example?

ina: Sure, from canary logs: 
```
{"type":"notify","payload":{"user":"alice","msg":"Payment received"}}}
...stream chopped...
```

kevin: Duplicate closing brace then cut. Sounds like a token ordering flip around '}' or a brief stutter where two tokens both look plausible and ordering changes under PTQ.

omar: Is this only on streaming? Any difference in sync (non-streamed) responses?

ina: Only streaming. Synchronous completes fine. Chunk traces show last chunk often 1 token shorter for PTQ.

ci-bot: Running structured-output-sanity(600) for marlin-tiny-ptq vs baseline. Also running token-align --focus=punc --samples=800. ETA ~3m.

kevin: Short-term idea: add a "stream-sentinel" probe for canary traffic. Heuristic: if output ends with punctuation + incomplete JSON signature, send a tiny resume token request (max_tokens=4) to try to finish. Flag resumed outputs.

omar: Resume probe could help but might hide root cause. I prefer to also add a non-invasive postprocess "dedupe+close" that removes duplicate closing punct and appends minimal closures, marked as REPAIRED. Keep raw in logs.

ina: Agree: opt-in resume for 5% canary, plus repair lib for all canary traffic. Add metrics: resumed_parse_rate, repaired_parse_rate, raw_parse_success.

infra-bot: Collected streaming-chunk histogram for canary: PTQ last-chunk-length mode=3 tokens vs float=5 tokens for long tails. Also captured last-token logit deltas for 120 samples. Uploaded to /canary/traces/marlin-tiny-ptq/3600123456.log

ci-bot: Results: marlin-tiny-ptq parse_success=91.0%, resumed_success=2.5%, repaired_success=4.0%, final_failure=2.5%. baseline parse_success=95.6%, repaired_success=0.7%, final_failure=3.7%. Full report: /canary/reports/marlin-tiny-ptq/3600123456.json

kevin: So rescue helps but raw parse gap ~4.6%. Token-align punc diffs show spikes at '}' and '"' tokens at tail positions. Looks like PTQ induced reordering on low-margin softmaxes.

omar: Plan: (1) run a quick PTQ calibration sweep: per-channel, per-tensor, and small-clipping configs on the same canary dataset; (2) run kv-cache-off canary to see if caching affects chunking; (3) keep resume+repair opt-in and track healed metrics.

ina: For release gate: hold broader rollout. Goal: raw parse_success >= 95.0% OR healed combined (parse+repaired+resumed) >= baseline_parse_success - 0.5% with repaired flagged. Prefer raw improvement.

ci-bot: Scheduled calibration sweep (3 configs) and kv-cache-off variant. I'll post updates when runs finish.

kevin: Also add a golden-prompt smoke: 500 critical prompts where structural integrity is crucial. Run those through each quant config to get early signal.

ina: Good call. I'll assemble the golden set and wire the dashboards for resumed_parse_rate and repaired_by_type (dedupe_close, append_brace, strip_trailing_comma).

omar: Thanks all. Keep notes concise in #incidents if we hit the roll-back gate. :thumbsup:
